output.title: Let's Encrypt account key labeling improves resource visibility
output.content: This change adds the app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: cert-manager label to Let's Encrypt account key secrets created by cert-manager. This metadata improves resource visibility and ownership tracking for ACME account keys. The environment uses cert-manager with Certificate resources, implying ACME usage for certificate issuance. This labeling enhancement is automatically applied to new account keys created during the upgrade.
